_about: Which images to make, in what order. Five families: A design sheets (one asset or a small set, alone on a plain backdrop), B surfaces (material boards, tiling textures, cut-out atlases), C shapes (plain single-object renders for the image-to-3D model), D frames (a capture of the game repainted in the style, keeping its layout), E states (one asset at three stages of its life; optional). tools/build_jobs.py expands this into one job per style. Written 2026-10-02.

batches.00-pilot: The images that tried every kind of job once or twice, in an easy style, a hard style and the sprite style. Run on 2026-10-02; the pack was revised from what came back.
batches.00b-pilot-rest: Seven images that gave the three styles the pilot left out the same two design sheets, and made the neon great tree again in neutral light. Run on 2026-10-02.
batches.01a-square-props: Thirty design sheets of single things that stand in and round the tree square (terrace furniture, street fixtures, street trees and palms, low planting, the tram shelter, the fountain), in the five styles whose sheets have been turned into game pieces. Run on 2026-10-02.
batches.01b-redo: Three design sheets asked for again after pieces were built from their first images: the anime great tree, whose crown the image-to-3D model built as a hollow ring, and the low-poly and neon seating sheets, whose perch seat was drawn as a stool. Run this next and stop.
batches.01-square: The tree square: what the street, diagonal and gathering views show most.
batches.02-city: The rest of what the game places today.
batches.03-shapes: Plain single-object renders for the image-to-3D model.
batches.04-life: Optional: seven assets at three stages of their life.

_frames_note: The pixel pack has one camera, so its gathering, park and workshop captures repeat its street capture; those frame jobs are skipped for it.

redo.neon_noir.A-great-tree: its first image (r001) is a night scene lit by the tree's own lamps, so its colours could not be used; the job now asks for neutral light and for lamps that throw no light on the tree

anime_cel.A-great-tree.why: its first image (r001) drew the crown as airy layers of small leaves with the branches showing through; the image-to-3D model built it as a hollow ring of thin leaf, three times over. The job now asks for a crown of large solid leaf clumps, closed all round and on top

lowpoly_tropical.A-seating.why: its first image (r001) drew the perch seat as a stool with legs; the job now describes it as the game uses it, a plain seat stone with a board on top. Only the perch seat of the new image will be used: the other three seats are built from r001
